posts.title: How I plan a city day in under 10 minutes
posts.body: Open TrekStak, pick the neighborhood, stak the stops you actually care about, and you are out the door with a route — not a 40-tab browser mess.

posts.title: Why I keep TrekStak off my main feed
posts.body: My Instagram stays travel and life. This page is where I drop TrekStak how-tos, codes, and updates so followers who want the app can find it without the spam.
